app.description: An app-owned workspace for synthetic development records.
app.publicNotice: Public development starter · synthetic data only · authentication is not enabled.
overview.title: A little structure. Room to make it yours.
overview.subtitle: Start with real saved records, then shape the interface and workflows around your needs.
overview.recentHint: The latest records saved in your local development database.
overview.foundationHint: Your theme, navigation and components live alongside your application source.
overview.customizationTitle: Keep the structure. Change the expression.
overview.customizationText: Choose a layout and theme, replace a component, or extend the record workflow in your own source. This starter makes no live AI, payment or production-security claim.
records.title: Small steps, saved.
records.subtitle: Create a synthetic record, move it forward, and come back to it later.
records.newHint: Use fictional details. These records persist in the development database.
records.emptyTitle: A clear page, ready for your first record.
records.emptyHint: Add a synthetic record using the form. Nothing is generated or sent on your behalf.
records.error.invalid: Check the record fields and try again.
records.error.notFound: This record is no longer available. Refresh records and try again.
records.error.stale: This record changed since it was loaded. Refresh records before trying again.
records.error.origin: This request did not come from the application’s allowed origin.
records.error.request: The records service could not complete the request. Check the local API and try again.
guide.title: The source is part of the product.
guide.subtitle: This development starter keeps its presentation and example workflow inside the generated project.
guide.configHint: Set the app name, theme preset, supported token values and navigation layout in the generated root configuration.
guide.componentsHint: Change the trusted source registry to replace the shell, record form or record card. Keep validated submissions, keyboard behavior and accessible errors intact.
guide.dataHint: The Python API owns record validation, revisions and persistence. Navigation visibility and a polished interface do not grant authorization.
guide.limitTitle: What this starter does not include
guide.limitHint: Password login, two-factor authentication, social providers, live AI, licensing, hosting and production operations are separate unfinished capabilities. Do not enter real customer data.
